correctness.rationale: For \(n=p^a m\) with \(m\) squarefree, the exponential-unitary divisors are exactly \(mp^d\) for \(d\parallel a\). Their harmonic mean is \(p^a m t_a/E_a(p)\). Because \(E_a(p)\equiv1\pmod p\), integrality reduces exactly to \(M_a(p)\mid m\). Squarefreeness gives the generator criterion, and standard squarefree counting with finitely many excluded primes gives the stated constant and \(O(\sqrt X)\) error. The bundled checker independently matched the criterion on \(36{,}025\) triples.

value.rationale: This is the complete first nonsquarefree stratum for exponential-unitary harmonicity: one repeated prime-power component and otherwise squarefree support. The theorem gives a sharp empty-versus-infinite dichotomy, an explicit generator, and an exact positive density when nonempty, rather than a routine finite slice or table extension.
